name: Video screens
description: Screens in the world (and a small overlay) that play YouTube, web pages, video files and streams.
setting.enabled.desc: Screens in the world and a small overlay for YouTube, web pages, files and streams.
setting.open.desc: New screen, or the controls of the one you look at (in a world).
setting.screens.desc: Look at a screen to control it, or anywhere to make a new one.
setting.others.desc: Screens shared by players with Vibey Client on this server.

status.needbrowser: Needs the browser – press the screens key
status.restart: Restart Minecraft to finish the browser setup
status.needffmpeg: Needs FFmpeg – press the screens key

controls.title: Screen
controls.shared: Other Vibey Client players here see it too
controls.overlay.desc: Small picture on your HUD, also far away.
controls.glow.desc: Always bright, even in the dark.
controls.share.desc: Only the link and play/pause travel.
setup.title: Setup
setup.done.restart: Installed. Restart Minecraft to use YouTube and web pages.
setup.nothing: Nothing is downloaded until you press the button.
setup.ffmpeg.title: Video files need FFmpeg
setup.ffmpeg.what: Files and direct video links are played with FFmpeg, a free open-source video program. It runs as its own program next to Minecraft.
setup.ffmpegmanual.title: Video files need FFmpeg
setup.ffmpegmanual.what: Files and direct video links are played with FFmpeg, a free open-source video program. Install it with your system's package manager, then press "Check again".
setup.mod.title: YouTube and web pages need a browser
setup.mod.what: YouTube (official YouTube player) and web pages are shown with MCEF Modern, a free mod that adds Chromium. It is installed into your mods folder; on first use it downloads Chromium.
setup.mod.size: 0.25 MB now, about {0} MB Chromium later
setup.natives.title: Get the browser?
setup.natives.what: MCEF Modern is installed. To show YouTube and web pages it needs to download Chromium once.
accept.title: {0} shared a screen
accept.body: Loading it connects your game to {0}, and it may play sound.
accept.setting: Change this in the settings: Other players' screens.
browser.title: Web page
browser.hint: Mouse and keyboard go to the page · Esc to leave
setup.ffmpegclips.title: Clips need FFmpeg
setup.ffmpegclips.what: Clips are recorded with FFmpeg, a free open-source video program, using your graphics card's video encoder. It runs as its own program next to Minecraft; it is the same download as for video screens.
setup.ffmpegmanualclips.title: Clips need FFmpeg
setup.ffmpegmanualclips.what: Clips are recorded with FFmpeg, a free open-source video program. Install it with your system's package manager, then press "Check again".
setup.done.clips: Done. The replay buffer records once you play.
